response.sql: WITH status_stats AS (SELECT s.healtheval, SUM(sc.scancount) as total_scancount, SUM(sc.gbsize) / NULLIF(SUM(sc.spanmin), 0.0) as gb_per_minute_rate FROM scans sc INNER JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.healtheval), avg_rate AS (SELECT AVG(gb_per_minute_rate) as average_rate FROM status_stats) SELECT ss.healtheval, ss.total_scancount, ss.gb_per_minute_rate, ss.gb_per_minute_rate - ar.average_rate as rate_minus_avg FROM status_stats ss CROSS JOIN avg_rate ar WHERE ss.gb_per_minute_rate > ar.average_rate ORDER BY ss.healtheval;
